join_order.probe: movie_info_idx via offsets_only index on movie_id
join_order.notes: Title is sorted by id and id is dense PK; driver is the ~3-4% selective year filter. Required: mi_idx row with info_type_id==it2_id AND info > '8.0'. Capture mi_idx.info for MIN.

join_order.probe: movie_info via offsets_only index on movie_id
join_order.notes: Existence check: row with info_type_id==it1_id AND info IN ('Drama','Horror'). Prune by length (5 or 6) before memcmp.

join_order.probe: movie_companies via offsets_only index on movie_id
join_order.notes: For each mc row with company_type_id==ct_id, lookup company_name.country_code[company_id-1]==us_code; capture cn.name for MIN.

data_structures.surviving_mids: flat_array<int32_t> (sequential mids appended in title id order)
data_structures.company_name_country_code: mmap int16_t[234997] direct array indexed by company_id-1
data_structures.min_accumulator: 3 byte buffers (movie_company, rating, drama_horror_movie) with byte-wise lex compare

parallelism.notes: Partition title.production_year scan into morsels; each thread maintains local MIN accumulators; merge at end with byte-wise MIN.

aggregation: scalar_min (3 columns, byte-wise lex compare, no GROUP BY)

string_compare.mi_idx.info_gt_8.0: memcmp against "8.0" then length tiebreak (longer string > if prefix matches)
string_compare.mi.info_in_set: length-prune (5 for 'Drama' or 6 for 'Horror'), then memcmp
string_compare.min_aggregation: byte-wise lex compare on raw varlen slices
